chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated mursal, saying:
It is narrated regarding a young girl who dies with a man, and he said: “If she is a girl less than five or six years old, she is buried and not washed.”
That is, it means that she is not given ghusl (ritual bath) stripped of her clothes; and that which indicates the obligation of her ghusl (ritual bath) is according to what he mentioned in the book.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on giving ghusl (ritual bath) to a young girl who dies when only a man is present?
ai.summary: This report addresses a legal ruling concerning the ghusl (ritual bath) of a young girl who dies in the presence of a man. It indicates that if she is below a certain age, she is buried without being washed in an uncovered state, while the closing note clarifies that the obligation of ghusl (ritual bath) itself is established elsewhere.
